design_philosophy: Fresh, clean, and functional. Blends the vibrant, appetite-stimulating aesthetics of a modern food delivery app (Zomato/Swiggy) with the clinical trust and clarity of a health and fitness platform. Strictly light theme with airy, floating components, ample whitespace, and strict color-coding for nutritional guidance.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-gray-900

grid_systems.menu_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8

food_cards.style: Flat background (#FFFFFF), rounded-3xl, 1px subtle border (#E5E7EB), overflow-hidden
food_cards.tags: Pill-shaped badges for calories and macros, positioned over the image or just below it.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF6B35] text-white hover:bg-[#E85D2A] rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 border-2 border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold transition-all active:scale-95

health_indicators.green: Use for low calorie / high protein (e.g., < 400 kcal)
health_indicators.yellow: Use for moderate balanced meals (e.g., 400 - 700 kcal)
health_indicators.red: Use for high calorie meals / cheat meals (e.g., > 700 kcal)
health_indicators.implementation: Small colored dot next to the item name, or a tinted background badge.

navigation.style: Sticky glassmorphism header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-100 z-50

hero_background.description: Woman enjoying healthy breakfast indoors. Overlay with a subtle white-to-transparent gradient to ensure text readability.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA standards against pure white. Do not use light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='login-submit', data-testid='filter-vegan'

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Manrope and Outfit fonts from Google Fonts.
Construct standard Shadcn UI components but heavily override them: add 'rounded-2xl' or 'rounded-3xl' for cards, strip harsh borders, and use soft shadows.
Strictly adhere to the light theme. DO NOT use dark mode toggles or dark backgrounds.
Implement the 'Health Indicators' color coding dynamically based on the nutritional properties of the food items.
For the BMI setup, use large, friendly inputs (Shadcn customized) and clear iconography.
The admin dashboard should use a dense 'Bento' grid, but remain entirely in light mode with high-contrast data visualization.
